scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun run test:bun && bun run test:daemon && bun run test:controller && bun run check:lock && bun run check:daemon
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/shared/test && tsc -p apps/daemon && tsc -p apps/service
scripts.check:daemon: out=$(mktemp -d) && bun build apps/daemon/src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile "$out/daemon.mjs" >/dev/null && cmp -s "$out/daemon.mjs" modal/sandbox/daemon.mjs; ok=$?; rm -rf "$out"; [ $ok = 0 ] || { echo 'modal/sandbox/daemon.mjs is stale. Run: bun run build:daemon' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.lock:controller: cd modal/controller && uv lock && uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-header --format requirements-txt --output-file requirements.lock
scripts.check:lock: cd modal/controller && out=$(uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-header --format requirements-txt && printf x) && [ "$out" = "$(cat requirements.lock && printf x)" ] || { echo 'requirements.lock does not match uv.lock, or uv export failed. Run: bun run lock:controller' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.test:it: T3MODAL_IT=1 uv run --directory modal/controller --locked pytest tests/it -s
